# Around Robin

> > Around Robin explores civil rights history, social justice, and African American heritage through the lens of filmmaker and historian Robin N Hamilton.

The site focuses extensively on civil rights leader Fannie Lou Hamer and the Mississippi Freedom Movement, while also examining broader topics including voting rights history, Free People of Color in Louisiana and New France, and contemporary social justice issues. Robin N Hamilton shares historical research, personal reflections from documentary work, and insights from encounters with activists like Angela Davis.

## Key Topics

- Fannie Lou Hamer
- Civil Rights Movement
- Voting Rights History
- Student Non-Violent Coordinating Committee (SNCC)
- Mississippi Freedom Struggle
- Robin N Hamilton
- African American Suffrage
- Free People of Color
- Creole History and Identity
- Social Justice Activism
- Reproductive Justice
- Women's Suffrage Movement
- 14th Amendment
- Colonial Louisiana and New France
- Documentary Filmmaking

## Fannie Lou Hamer and the Mississippi Freedom Movement

- [Fannie Lou Hamer Sterilization](https://www.aroundrobin.com/fannie-lou-hamer-sterilization): Forced sterilization and reproductive injustice against Fannie Lou Hamer
- [Fannie Lou Hamer's Interview](https://www.aroundrobin.com/fannie-lou-hamers-interview): Interview content with SNCC and Mississippi Free Democratic Party leader
- [Speaking Of Mrs. Fannie Lou Hamer](https://www.aroundrobin.com/speaking-of-mrs-fannie-lou-hamer): Personal reflection on documenting civil rights activist Fannie Lou Hamer
- [Bombing Of Williams Chapel Missionary Church](https://www.aroundrobin.com/bombing-of-williams-chapel-missionary-church): Civil rights era church bombing in Ruleville, Mississippi
- [Fannie Lou Hamer Quotes](https://www.aroundrobin.com/fannie-lou-hamer-quotes): Collection of inspirational quotes from civil rights leader Fannie Lou Hamer

## Voting Rights and Civil Rights History

- [Black Suffrage – A History of African American Voting Rights](https://www.aroundrobin.com/african-american-voting-rights): Comprehensive history of African American voting rights in the US
- [Brown v. Board of Education](https://www.aroundrobin.com/brown-v-board-of-education): Landmark Supreme Court case ending school segregation analysis
- [Women's Suffrage Movement](https://www.aroundrobin.com/women-suffrage-movement): History of women's voting rights and the 19th Amendment movement
- [The Importance Of Social Justice](https://www.aroundrobin.com/importance-of-social-justice): Commentary on social justice, equality and Black Lives Matter movement

## Activists and Historical Figures

- [Angela Davis – My takeway when I met the activist legend](https://www.aroundrobin.com/angela-davis): Personal encounter with activist Angela Davis and Black Panther Party history
- [Let's Talk Odessa](https://www.aroundrobin.com/lets-talk-odessa): Profile of Odessa Madre, DC numbers runner and Club Madre proprietor

## Free People of Color and Creole History

- [The Free People of Color – Definition, Context and Disambiguation](https://www.aroundrobin.com/free-people-of-color): Historical analysis of Free People of Color in Louisiana and New France

## Optional

- [Why A DIY Promotional Video Is A Bad Idea](https://www.aroundrobin.com/why-a-diy-promotional-video-is-a-bad-idea): Professional video production advice from ARound Robin Production Company
